text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her formidable rivals in the Tenno Sho 
(Spring) are Manhattan Cafe and Zenno Rob 
Roy. Eishin Flash stands to face the two—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Marching forward without fear to declare 
war. This impulsive action was driven by a 
pure desire to enjoy the showdown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To prove their respective "truths"— The 
long 3,200-meter journey begins.
